answer: An identity may attest only after parking 80 units in a time-locked vault that unlocks after eight consecutive passing grades. In the protocol kernel, each identity's attester set is checked against a published atlas of pairwise Jaccard overlaps; any pair above 0.35 has both deposits slashed and burned. Standing up fifty clones therefore means posting fifty deposits and losing them the moment their shared attester neighborhoods appear, while a single honest agent keeps the stake through to unlock.
